runs.title: Runs
runs.subtitle: File and process scans: queued, running and finished

profiles.summary: CPU up to {{cpu}} · memory up to {{memory}} · {{workers}} in parallel

empty.title: No scans yet
empty.description: Start a file or process scan to see the results here.
empty.readerDescription: When an operator starts a scan or a schedule runs, the results show up here.
empty.filteredDescription: Change the filters or clear them to see every run.

new.title: New scan
new.description: The scan is queued and runs within the limits of the chosen resource profile.
new.kindFilesHint: Scans the files under the given paths with the signature engines.
new.kindProcessesHint: Inspects running processes, network connections and startup mechanisms.
new.pathsHint: One absolute path per line, such as /home or /var/www. Up to 64.
new.excludeHint: One absolute path per line; anything inside stays out of the scan. Up to 256.
new.incremental: Skip files unchanged since the last scan
new.incrementalHint: Reuses the previous result when the file and the engine versions are the same. Uncheck to scan everything again.
new.profileHint: Sets how much CPU, memory and disk the scan may use.
new.profilesError: Could not load the profiles ({{cause}}). The scan will use the standard profile.

errors.pathsRequired: Enter at least one path or choose server accounts.
errors.notAbsolute: Use absolute paths starting with /. Fix: {{path}}
errors.accountsRequired: Choose at least one account from the list or switch to "All accounts".

new.pathsOptionalHint: Optional when accounts are chosen: the server builds each account scope. One absolute path per line. Up to 64.

detail.title: Run {{id}}
detail.notFoundDescription: Run {{id}} does not exist or was removed by retention.
detail.enginesEmptyActive: Each engine's coverage shows up when the scan finishes.
detail.enginesEmpty: No engine reported coverage for this run.
detail.walkSkipped: Left out while walking the paths
detail.walkSkippedHint: Items that never reached the engines, counted while walking the paths.
detail.pausedNote: Run paused: its processes are frozen until you resume it.
detail.pauseUnavailable: Pausing needs systemd 246 or newer with cgroup v2, which this server lacks.
detail.limitsHint: The new limit applies right away, without restarting the run.
detail.cancelImpact: The scan stops now and the run's processes are terminated. What was already scanned and the findings found so far stay recorded.
detail.cancelQueuedImpact: The run leaves the queue and never starts.

engine.errorsCaption: Engine failure messages and how many files each one affected
engine.skipCaption: Reasons items were left out of the scan and how many of each

excluded.label: Excluded for this scan
excluded.description: The path is in the exclusion list requested for this scan.

too_large.label: Above the size limit
too_large.description: The file exceeds the resource profile's maximum size and was not read.

permission.label: No read permission
permission.description: The system denied reading the file. It may have the immutable attribute, sit on a restricted mount or be exclusively locked.

not_regular.label: Not a regular file
not_regular.description: Symlink, device, FIFO or socket: there is no file content to scan.

changed_during_read.label: Changed while being read
changed_during_read.description: The file changed while it was being read; the result was discarded so it would not be wrong. It will be scanned next time.

timeout.label: Timed out
timeout.description: The engine took too long on the file and the scan was stopped.

engine_error.label: Engine failure
engine_error.description: The engine could not scan the file. The failure messages are listed below.

other_filesystem.label: Another file system
other_filesystem.description: The path is on another disk or mount (network, virtual file system) and was not walked.

cached.label: Unchanged (cache)
cached.description: Already scanned with the same engine and rule versions; the previous result was reused and counts as scanned.

skip.unknownDescription: Reason reported by the executor that this panel version cannot explain yet.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.subtitle: What the engines managed to scan and why anything was left out
coverage.noLastFiles: No file scan has finished yet.
coverage.noLastProcesses: No process scan has finished yet.
coverage.glossaryIntro: An eligible file may be left out of an engine's scan for one of these reasons. Coverage below 100% is not a failure in itself, but items left out were not checked.
coverage.noEngines: This run did not report coverage by engine.
coverage.runError: Could not load the coverage for this run: {{cause}}

overview.subtitle: Open findings, scans and the health of this server
overview.noLastFiles: No file scan has finished yet.
overview.noLastProcesses: No process scan has finished yet.
overview.firstDescription: Start with a file scan of the account directories (for example /home) to get a first picture of this server.
overview.firstDescriptionReader: When an operator or a schedule starts the first scan, the results show up here.
overview.noSchedules: No schedules configured: scans only run when someone starts them.
